$comment: Project-wide Claude Code settings for CloudFuze Studio Migrate. Personal overrides go in settings.local.json (git-ignored). These permissions favor read/typecheck/build/git-status operations and BLOCK anything that would touch secrets or production credentials. Normal pushes to non-default branches (e.g. business) are allowed; force pushes and any push to main/master remain blocked.

$editingBoundaries.note: Do not edit generated/build output (server/dist, web/dist), lockfiles unless intentionally bumping deps, or any credential file. Diagnostic scripts (server/src/spikes/_diag_*, _test_*, _demo_*, _poc_*) are throwaway spikes — do not treat them as app code or refactor them.
